history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young, East Asian man with dark, messy, voluminous hair is sitting in the passenger seat of a car at night. He is wearing a plain black t-shirt and light-colored shorts with some text visible on the left leg. His left arm is resting on his leg, and his right arm is extended towards the camera, creating a selfie perspective. He has a neutral, slightly curious expression.

The interior of the car is dimly lit, with the overhead light on, casting a cool, blueish-white glow on the ceiling and parts of the car's interior. The seats appear to be black fabric. Through the window on the right, the night outside is dark, with only faint reflections visible. On the left side of the car, behind the man, there's a glimpse of a black seat and a metal grille, suggesting it might be a pickup truck or an SUV with a cargo area.

The overall mood is casual and intimate, typical of a nighttime car selfie. The lighting is low-key, with a focus on the man's face and upper body. The color palette is dominated by dark tones of black and gray, with the beige of the shorts and the soft skin tone of the man providing contrast. The image has a slightly grainy quality, common in low-light photography. The style is realistic, capturing a candid moment.
